title: Recipes for items, fluids or building. Used only from the schema.

time.title: The time in seconds to complete craft this recipe.

power.title: The amount of power used to complete this recipe.

crafter.title: A list of element behavior ID that the crafter needs to be able to craft this recipe.

input.title: The dictionary of element [name, int] to describe the recipe inputs.

output.title: The dictionary of element [name, int] to describe the recipe outputs.
